observation: HA fails to induce Smad2/3/4 nuclear relocation in WWOX-deficient cells; PNNs are HA-based and ensheath PV cells
relation_hypothesised: WWOX loss impairs HA sensing, disrupting PNN assembly and delaying PV maturation, lowering seizure threshold
possible_action: PNN-modifying or PNN-integrity-restoring interventions (no agent named)
context: Non-neuronal WWOX-deficient cells for the HA step; PV-PNN relation from ECM literature; mouse cortex implied for test
benefit_to_verify: Whether PV maturation or seizure threshold improves when PNN integrity is restored
favourable_reason: Specific to PV cells, ties to epilepsy, testable by WFA staining
unfavourable_or_alternative: HA link shown only outside neurons; PNN change could be secondary; competing explanations A, C-F
discriminating_experiment: WFA/aggrecan coverage around PV cells across development in WWOX-deficient versus control cortex, correlated with fast-spiking index
reasoning_pattern: A mechanism shown in one cell type is transferred to another cell type by way of a shared pathway component and a shared downstream structure

observation: IPSC amplitude and frequency both fall on pyramidal cells
relation_hypothesised: Amplitude component reflects a postsynaptic GABA-A deficit on the mutant pyramidal cell
context: Pyramidal cells in acute slices; P13-17; global or pan-neuronal knockout
benefit_to_verify: Whether quantal amplitude and GABA responses are reduced on pyramidal cells
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (amplitude fall, one study); relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Only single mechanism predicting an amplitude drop; pyramidal cell is itself mutant
unfavourable_or_alternative: Amplitude could change through presynaptic or maturation routes (report allows B partly); composite signal
discriminating_experiment: mIPSC amplitude plus GABA-puff dose-response and pharmacology on pyramidal cells; interneuron-restricted versus pyramidal-restricted deletion
reasoning_pattern: A readout component is assigned to the side of the synapse whose property alone predicts it, by elimination of other single mechanisms

relation_hypothesised: PV cells have intrinsic fast-spiking failure
context: PV cells, P13-17 onwards; mouse cortex implied
benefit_to_verify: Whether PV rheobase, maximum firing, AP width or Kv3 current are altered
favourable_reason: Frequency fall is compatible with D
unfavourable_or_alternative: Compatible equally with A, B, E; no PV data exist
discriminating_experiment: Patch identified PV cells for rheobase, maximum firing, AP half-width, Kv3 current
reasoning_pattern: A functional deficit is inferred from a population readout and matched to a channel-class drug

relation_hypothesised: Fewer PV cells (loss or mis-positioning, possibly through disrupted MGE-derived migration)
possible_action: Boost surviving-cell output; avoid agents that further suppress inhibition (no agent named)
context: Cortex across ages and layers; MGE-derived interneurons
benefit_to_verify: Whether PV+ and GAD67+ counts are lower than a Cre-independent marker count
favourable_reason: Frequency fall compatible; KB migration node exists
unfavourable_or_alternative: Marker loss without cell loss (C); delay (B); migration node has unknown intermediates
discriminating_experiment: Stereological PV+ and GAD67+ counts across ages versus Cre-independent marker; age time-course
reasoning_pattern: Cell loss is distinguished from marker loss by a marker-independent count

observation: IPSC deficit seen only at P13-17
relation_hypothesised: Delayed rather than permanent PV maturation, partly explaining both frequency and amplitude
possible_action: Pro-maturation or critical-period modulation, possibly limited to a developmental window
context: Developing cortex, ages P10 to adult
benefit_to_verify: Whether IPSC deficit recovers with age
favourable_reason: Transient deficit would fit a developmental disorder
unfavourable_or_alternative: Permanent loss indistinguishable with one age; no time-course
discriminating_experiment: IPSC time-course P10-adult with animal-level n; WFA, Kv3.1, fast-spiking index across ages
reasoning_pattern: A single time point is read as a snapshot of a trajectory and the trajectory is then proposed as the drug target window

relation_hypothesised: Reduced excitatory drive onto PV interneurons
possible_action: Enhance excitatory drive onto interneurons, e.g. AMPA-kinetics modulation
benefit_to_verify: Whether EPSCs onto identified PV cells are reduced
unfavourable_or_alternative: Indistinguishable from A, B, D with present data; raising excitatory drive in an epileptic brain is not discussed
discriminating_experiment: Record EPSCs onto identified PV cells
reasoning_pattern: A presynaptic readout is traced to the input of the presynaptic cell, one step upstream

observation: PV/GAD67 protein may fall while function stays intact
relation_hypothesised: Marker-only reduction; PV marker is a biomarker, not a target
benefit_to_verify: Whether light-evoked PV-to-pyramidal IPSC per connection is preserved despite lower immunostain
favourable_reason: Would spare patients unnecessary GABAergic drugs
unfavourable_or_alternative: Does not itself explain the reduced IPSC that was observed
discriminating_experiment: PV-Cre;ChR2 light-evoked IPSC per connection versus PV immunostaining
reasoning_pattern: A reduced marker is separated from reduced function by an activity-based readout

observation: Synapsin I-Cre is pan-neuronal; no interneuron-restricted model exists
relation_hypothesised: Cell autonomy to PV or interneuron lineage is unresolved
possible_action: Generate Nkx2.1-Cre, Dlx5/6-Cre or PV-Cre WWOX deletions; compare with pyramidal-restricted deletion; add IPSC/PV endpoints to organoid and AAV9 paradigms
benefit_to_verify: Whether an interneuron-restricted deletion reproduces the IPSC deficit and localises the amplitude effect
unfavourable_or_alternative: Phenotype could be network-secondary; non-cell-autonomous effects already seen for myelin
discriminating_experiment: Interneuron-restricted versus pyramidal-restricted conditional deletion with identical IPSC readouts
reasoning_pattern: A pan-cell-type model is replaced by lineage-restricted models to assign a phenotype to a cell type
